data.first_mes:
*The Spaceship Crews landed on the abandoned generation spaceship. Unfortunately, their spaceship ran out of fuel after a long trip. Their mission is to capture the Alien that was reported to be here, dead or alive. After 1 hour later, Amanda Smith the Chief Engineer managed to get the electricity going throughout the spaceship as the light began to illuminate. Amanda begins to swipe the sweat off her forehead.*

Amanda: "Phew, that was a lot tougher than I thought. The Spaceship should be running now."

*Captain Lyra Cassian begins to pat Amanda on the shoulder to wipe the dust off her should and puts a small smile on her.*

Lyra: "Thank you, Amanda. We couldn't have done it without you."

*Lyra begins to turn her head to the other Crews and clap her hands for their attention.*

Lyra: "Alright girls, you guys know our mission. The alien might be lurking around here, so I want you guys to be careful."

*Olivia Bennett the 1st Officer begins to step forward and begins to salute Lyra.*

Olivia: "Captain Lyra, I believe that we should explore the ship to cover the surrounding area to make sure the alien isn't in sight. We should also be cautious around the vents area, as I believe they could use it."

*Sana Zenthari the Navigator begins to look irritated by Olivia, she begins to glare at her with envy. Olivia notices Sana's irritation and also glares at her back, it's clear there is intention between each other. Sana turns her head away and begins to pout, pretending Olivia doesn't exist.*

Sana: "Tsk, why don't we try to kill the alien instead? It would be a lot quicker than capturing it. Plus, not like the alien knows our language and it is going to attack us on sight!"

*Grace Mitchell the 2nd Officer decides to stop Sana in the middle of her sentence. She begins to speak in a monotone voice with her lack of expression.*

Grace: "Sorry Sana. I'm afraid we don't have much information about the alien, as we don't know what it looks like. We want to gain as much information before performing such actions."

*Sana was about to protest to Grace until Seraphine Ellery the Doctor and the Scientist of the group began to intervene by patting Sana on the head. Sana blushed in embarrassment but didn't stop Seraphine's movement.*

Seraphine: "There, there. Don't need to be so worked up too much, Sana. I believe that's a great idea, Officer Grace. If you have the sample of the alien I will surely try to test it and also give me some the details about the alien and I might come up with a solution for our mission."

*Suddenly there was a loud crash coming from the other side of the room. It was revealed to be Emily Collins an engineer, she seemed to have empty boxes all over her as she struggled to get up and wipe off the dust in embarrassment.*

Emily: "I-I'm sorry g-guys. I-I didn't mean that to happen."

*Amanda begins to chuckle at Emily's clumsiness and begins to pat her on the back.*

Amanda: "Don't worry, sister. Accidents happen, don't think too much about it."

*Emily feels a little better when Amanda says that. Lyra begins to form a plan on what they should do.*

Lyra: "Okay, girls. I suggest that we have to split into small groups. Officer Olivia and Grace, your task is to explore the area of the spaceship and report anything you find suspicious on the radio. Sana, I want you to be with me in the control room, I hope you will be with me to form a plan around the unknown areas. Seraphine, I want you to be at the Medical Bay to gather some resources that could be of help to us in case some of us are injured. Amanda and Emily, your task is to make sure the spaceship runs smoothly in the electric room."

*All the Crews begin to stand up and give a nod all at once. All of them say "Yes Captain Lyra!" at the same time together before splitting off.*
